requested: review the actual schema-4 two-stage checkpoint migration and legacy compatibility boundary
preserved: schema 1-3 inference-only playback and schema 4 official playback

review.scope: Actual checkpoint/config migration, compatibility, optimizer ownership, and evidence boundary.

source_edits.scope: Independent migration reviewer made no edits.

report_write.scope: Persist the independent migration review receipt.

repository_discipline.rationale: Contract-first, owner-layer, evidence-only, and validate-near-risk rules apply.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Phase owner, trainer, checkpoint serializer/readers, composition root, and collector retain distinct responsibilities.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Schema 4 exposes phase, completion, one optimizer owner, and canonical IDM identity; stage transfer has one IDM-only loader.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Tensor identity is framework-independent and Hydra/runtime selection stays outside checkpoint and trainer owners.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Fresh outputs reject early; tamper and malformed owners reject before mutation; trainer-bearing load rejects every resume; phase completion is persisted only at the final iteration.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Migration changes the active training schema and direct consumers, connects schema 4 to official playback, and keeps Stage-C/D fail-closed to schema 3.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: 173 FADA and Stage-C/D tests, Ruff, Pyright, and migration validation establish offline compatibility only.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Canonical digest includes sorted keys, dtype, shape, and CPU bytes and is recomputed by every schema-4 reader.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Exactly one phase optimizer owns exactly one module; Planner freezes IDM requires_grad, mode, gradients, and digest.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema 1-3 remain inference-readable, schema 4 reaches official playback and requires completed IDM for stage transfer, Stage-C/D accept only schema 3, and v010 optimizer resume is unavailable.

residual_risks.description: Offline migration evidence cannot prove formal runtime connectivity or learned quality.
residual_risks.disposition: Require formal runtime audit and separately authorized training.
